notes.title: Fractal 0.5
notes.notes:
[h1] Update 0.5 out! We are nearing the end! [/h1]

Thanks again for waiting, Update 0.5 is out! L! Along with it is a short teaser of the new as of new surprises!

https://youtu.be/RLyNA6CcjmM

[h1] NEW FEATURES [/h1]

[b] New levels for both Normal and Survival mode	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Two new levels that you have to experience for yourselves
[/list]

[b] Newly refined brush  [/b]
[list]
    [*]New brush design for all brush types
    [*]New brush that extends its range, but remains melee style
[/list]


[h1] UPDATED FEATURES [/h1]

[b] Updated rune system	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Updated visuals
    [*]Adjusted some numbers and stats on existing runes
[/list]

[b] UI / menu improvements / additions [/b]
[list]
    [*]Updated level select and rune menus
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to previous levels	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Lighting changes
    [*]Performance improvements across the board
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to enemy spawn timers / numbers [/b]	
[list]
    [*]Tweaked difficulty with spawn numbers and attack times
    [*]Adjusted spawn locations for each level, taken into account newly added levels
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to existing gameplay numbers [/b]	
[list]
    [*]Balance changes to various gameplay elements
[/list]

Please check out the update and discover all the many additions and a big surprise!



Fractal Team

notes.title: Fractal Update 0.3 out today!
notes.notes:
[h1] Update 0.3 finally out! [/h1]

Thanks for everyone’s patience, Update 0.3 is out! Tons of new features and gameplay! Along with it is a short teaser of the new additions.

https://youtu.be/jySj73YP1Ks

[h1] NEW FEATURES [/h1]

[b] New Language Support [/b]
[list]
    [*]Simplified Chinese 
    [*]Traditional Chinese
[/list]

[b] New enemy types [/b]
[list]
    [*]Cute, slow moving enemies but deadly once close to you 
    [*]Stealthy enemy that will surprise even veteran brush wielders
[/list]

[b] New levels for both Normal and Survival mode	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Many new environments and terrains to explore and conquer
    [*]Many new narrative hints and environmental storytelling for keen eyed 
    [*]players
[/list]

[b] New brush and spell [/b]
[list]
    [*]New brush style to give you more options, this one focusing on defense
    [*]New spell with 2 modes, both defensive
[list]
    [*]First: a handheld shield that give you the ability to block and bash you enemies
    [*]Second: expand your shield into a large immovable phalanx shield that protects you from enemies coming from a certain direction
[/list]
[/list]

[b] New enemy death visual decals [/b]
[list]
    [*]New visual way to see your achievements after finishing a level
[list]
    [*]Enemies will now leave a visual mark when they are defeated at their location of death, in conjunction with their color at the time of death
[/list]
[/list]


[h1] UPDATED FEATURES [/h1]

[b] Updated rune system	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Ability to purchase existing runes using collected crystals
    [*]Adjusted some numbers and stats on existing runes
    [*]Ability to unlock newly mentioned brush and spell
[/list]

[b] Updated audio effects [/b]
[list]
    [*]New audio effects for newly added brushes, spells, enemies and levels
    [*]New audio effects have been added so that each enemy has a distinct spawn sound
    [*]Updated audio effects for varies events
[/list]

[b] UI / menu improvements / additions [/b]
[list]
    [*]Updated level select and rune menus
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to previous levels	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Lighting changes
    [*]Performance improvements
    [*]Overall increased visual fidelity
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to enemy spawn timers / numbers [/b]	
[list]
    [*]Tweaked difficulty with spawn numbers and attack times
    [*]Adjusted spawn locations for each level, taken into account newly added levels
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to existing gameplay numbers [/b]	
[list]
    [*]Balance changes to previous brushes and sphere damage and cool down times
[/list]

Please check out the update and discover all the many additions and a few surprises!



Fractal Team

notes.title: Upcoming patch content sneak peak!
notes.notes:
Most of this new patch will bring a slew of new content to the world of Fractal. Details will be in the patch notes along with the actual update. Again it will be soon, so please be patient with us. 

But for those of you who follow us on Twitter (https://twitter.com/PhospheneDesign) and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/fractalVR/), you will have already seen some sneak peaks of our upcoming levels as well as some narrative hints at what can you expect and what’s to come. Some are story hints and maybe even hints at future levels and the history in the world of Fractal and why the world is in disarray. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27421742/1213a1b4a9d638e1f8c7662e76aaf64590d9f874.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27421742/f75e54cff74f8c813fb03028a9ebd89331ce40ff.png[/img]

Yes there will be new brush tips for you to find and equip, there will be of course, new environments that will have amazing vistas and some clues to what happened to this world. There will be new (frightening) enemies for you to find and conquer. And finally yes, there will be support for both Traditional and Simplified Chinese languages. 

So please stay tuned, follow us on Twitter and Facebook for the latest updates, as the new patch will be out very soon!



-Fractal Team

notes.title: Update 0.2 live now!
notes.notes:
Update 0.2 is out! Thanks for being patient with us since launch. Here is the update trailer as well as a list of improvements, fixes and additions that this update brings!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JDoPpuOUozE

[h1] NEW FEATURES	[/h1]

[b] New enemy type	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Ranged enemy that is able to attack even when you are surrounded
    [*]Increased verticality as enemy will attack from above you as well
[/list]

[b] New level for both Normal and Survival mode	[/b]
[list]
    [*]New environment
    [*]New narrative hints and environmental storytelling 
[/list]

[b] New loot drop system	[/b]
[list]
    [*]1 loot box per level completed
    [*]Potential drops will include either currency or 1 rune
    [*]Runes will be added to your rune page
[list]

       [*]Duplicate runes will be exchanged for currency
[/list]
    [*]Currency will be used for buying various in game items (used in a future patch)
[/list]
      
[b] New rune system	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Runes for both brush and sphere added
[list]
       [*]Split into power runes and support runes
[list]
          [*]Power runes will affect either brush or sphere
          [*]Power runes will fundamentally change the way you play
          [*]Only one power rune can be equipped for each hand at once
          [*]Support runes will have various effects and could affect either or both brush and / or sphere
          [*]Support runes will have different tiers with varying degrees of effectiveness
          [*]Only 2 support runes can be equipped at once
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
         
[b] New level select system	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Ability to select and replay levels from Normal mode after you beat each level
[/list]


[h1]UPDATED FEATURES	[/h1]

[b] UI / menu improvements / additions	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Main menu arrangement
    [*]Level select and rune menus
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to previous levels	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Lighting changes
    [*]Performance improvements
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to enemy spawn timers / numbers	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Tweaked difficulty with spawn numbers and attack times
[/list]

[b] Tweaks to existing gameplay numbers	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Balance changes to main brush and sphere damage and cool down times
[/list]

Please check out the update and discover all the many additions that are available this patch!



Fractal Team

notes.title: Fractal upcoming updates and patches
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

First of all thanks to all of you who gave our game a chance and we really appreciate your patience in awaiting the next update!

Speaking of our next update, we are hard at work on many additions including new enemies and enemy types that will really put a new spin on the gameplay and challenge those already familiar with the game. New levels and environments are also coming, with additions to previous levels. One of the most exciting features: the rune/loot system, will be implemented soon as well, and we are trying our best to fit it into the next update!

We plan to have several big updates that will introduce new gameplay options and much much more quality gameplay content each month until release (4-6 months away).

One important thing is that we wish for all of you who find bugs or glitches that slipped through our testing, to report them here so we can work on fixing them ASAP. Thank you!

That's all for now, so please look forward to the next big update that will come very soon, so stay tuned, and thanks for your patience!


Fractal Team
